summary: Bulk task operations feature passed QA review.

checks.name: Multi-select functionality
checks.details: Ctrl+click toggles individual card selection. Shift+click selects range. Normal click opens detail panel. Selection is tracked via selectedIds Set.

checks.name: Bulk move to phase
checks.details: Bulk action bar appears with selected count. Move-to dropdown dispatches moveTask for each selected card. Selection cleared after move.

checks.name: Bulk delete
checks.details: Confirmation dialog shown. Calls bulkDeleteTasks server action. Selection cleared after delete.

checks.name: Selection visuals
checks.details: Selected cards shown with blue ring and checkmark badge. Deselect and clear buttons visible in action bar.

checks.name: Accessibility
checks.details: Skippable — keyboard-only multi-select (with checkboxes) could be improved but current implementation is functional via modifier keys.
